announcement.open: Applications are now open for the First Founding Entrepreneur Cohort.

hero.title: Begin Your Entrepreneur Journey.
hero.description: Apply as an Individual Entrepreneur or as an Organization / Group Enterprise. EPEW will guide qualified applicants through preparation, development, and structured community-supported business funding.
hero.requirements: No credit requirement. No collateral requirement. No job requirement. Your commitment, preparation, and business or enterprise project are what matter.
hero.disclaimer: EPEW is not a lender, bank, broker-dealer, investment company, or investment adviser. Entrepreneur support depends on qualification, preparation, supporter participation, business readiness, and ecosystem conditions.

process.title: Before You Begin
process.description: The application begins by identifying where the enterprise will operate and whether the applicant is an individual entrepreneur or an organization. Your answers determine the correct EPEW enrollment path.

steps.one_description: Tell us where the enterprise is primarily based and whether you are applying as an individual or as an organization.
steps.two_description: Create your EPEW entrepreneur account and provide the information required for your selected application path.
steps.three_description: After submission, complete your communication preferences and Entrepreneur Questionnaire so EPEW can continue the review process.
steps.four_description: EPEW reviews your application, prepares the interview and qualification process, and determines whether the applicant is ready to continue into business preparation.

application.title: Apply to Become an EPEW Entrepreneur
application.subtitle: Start by selecting the country where the proposed enterprise or mutual project will primarily operate.

geographic.title: Step 1 — Enterprise Location
geographic.question: Where will this enterprise primarily operate?
geographic.country_placeholder: Select or enter the enterprise country
geographic.domestic_notice: Applicants based in the United States or Canada may apply as an Individual Entrepreneur or as an Organization / Group Enterprise.
geographic.international_notice: Applicants outside the United States and Canada must currently apply as an Organization / Group Enterprise unless an established business owner receives EPEW approval through the International Individual Special Request process.

classification.title: Step 2 — Applicant Type
classification.question: Who is applying?
classification.individual_description: I am applying as one entrepreneur for one business idea, proposed business, or existing business.
classification.organization_description: We are applying together as one organization for one mutual enterprise project.
classification.special_description: I operate an established business outside the United States or Canada and would like EPEW to review a request for individual participation.
classification.organization_rule: An Organization / Group Enterprise is treated as one enterprise application, one mutual project, one qualification decision, and one funding position.
classification.organization_minimum: An organization application must include at least 3 active participants.

demographic.title: Optional Demographic Information
demographic.description: EPEW collects this information only to understand the communities we serve and improve community outreach. Your answer is optional and will not affect your application, qualification, funding eligibility, or access to services.

individual.title: Step 4 — Individual Entrepreneur Business Information
individual.business_name: Business Idea or Proposed Business Name
individual.business_description: Describe your business idea, proposed business, or existing business in a few sentences.
individual.affiliation_question: Are you currently affiliated with any organization or association?

organization.title: Step 4 — Organization / Group Enterprise
organization.expected_jobs: Expected Jobs to Be Created — Optional
organization.resources_required: Major Equipment or Resources Needed — Optional
organization.financing_notice: The organization has one financing position. Participant count does not multiply the funding amount. Requested financing cannot exceed $100,000 for this organizational enterprise application.
organization.use_of_financing: How will the financing be used?

participants.title: Step 5 — Organization Participants
participants.description: Add the active participants who will work together on the mutual enterprise project. At least 3 active participants are required before final submission.

international_special_request.title: International Individual Special Request
international_special_request.intro: This request is only for established business owners outside the United States and Canada who want EPEW to consider an exception to the current organization-only international application rule.
international_special_request.notice: Submitting this request does not create an Entrepreneur Application and does not guarantee approval. If approved, EPEW will authorize you to continue through the Individual Entrepreneur application path.
international_special_request.website: Website or Business Social Presence — Optional
international_special_request.request_reason: Explain why you are requesting individual participation with EPEW.
international_special_request.supporting_evidence: Supporting Evidence or Document Description — Optional
international_special_request.success_message: Your International Individual Special Request has been received and is pending EPEW review.

verification.title: Identity Verification
verification.government_id_help: Required. Upload a clear photograph or PDF of a valid government-issued identification document. Maximum size: 10 MB.
verification.selfie_help: Required. Take or upload a clear photograph of yourself for identity verification. Maximum size: 6 MB.

agreements.purpose_text: EPEW supports entrepreneurs through preparation, coaching, business development, partner services, platform coordination, and structured community participation.
agreements.role_text: EPEW provides platform organization, entrepreneur preparation, communication tools, coordination, and business-development support. EPEW does not guarantee qualification, funding, business success, profitability, supporter participation, or marketplace approval.
agreements.qualification_text: Submitting an application begins the EPEW review process. Qualification depends on application review, questionnaire completion, interview, readiness, preparation, and applicable EPEW requirements.
agreements.entity_text: Before business launch or funding eligibility, the entrepreneur or organization may be required to establish or maintain a valid legal business entity and complete applicable registration, identification, licensing, banking, insurance, and compliance requirements.
agreements.risk_text: The applicant understands that qualification, community participation, funding, business success, and profitability are not guaranteed.
agreements.disclaimer_text: EPEW acts as a platform coordinator and administrative organizer. EPEW is not a lender, bank, broker-dealer, investment company, or investment adviser.
agreements.organization_governance_text: The organization confirms that its authorized representatives and participants are acting together for one mutual enterprise project. The organization is responsible for participant accuracy, internal authority, team accountability, and changes in membership.
agreements.organization_funding_text: The organization understands that the application represents one enterprise and one funding position. The number of participants does not create separate funding positions.
agreements.accept_individual: I have read, understand, and agree to the Individual Entrepreneur Participation Agreement.
agreements.accept_organization: I have read, understand, and agree to the Organization Entrepreneur Participation Agreement.
agreements.application_acknowledgment: I understand that this is an application and enrollment request, not a guarantee of qualification, public listing, funding, campaign completion, or business approval. I agree to follow the EPEW preparation and qualification process.

validation.selfie_required: Please upload or take a selfie verification photo.
validation.agreement_required: You must accept the applicable participation agreement before submitting.
validation.submission_error: Unable to submit your application. Please review your information and try again.
validation.unexpected_error: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.

submit.login: Sign in to your entrepreneur account

success.title: Application Submitted Successfully
success.message: Your EPEW Entrepreneur Application has been received.
success.account_confirmation: Check your email and follow the confirmation link to activate your entrepreneur account when applicable.
success.review: EPEW will review your application and supporting information.
success.interview: If your application advances, EPEW will prepare the interview and qualification process.
success.qualification: Qualified applicants continue into the EPEW business-preparation process.
success.coach: A Personal Coach is assigned as part of the approved development workflow.
